name: sharepoint-2026-poc
description: PoC, IOCs, and detection logic for the SharePoint /_trust WS-Federation BinaryFormatter deserialization chain. Lab reconstruction covering unauthenticated RCE, in-process machine key theft, and the artifacts each variant leaves behind. SharePoint 2016, 2019, and Subscription Edition. CVE-2026-50522, CVE-2026-45659, CVE-2026-56164, CVE-2026-58644.
